## Intent
The janitor - a self-hosting maintainer. Each cycle it scans the program store and the intake register and refreshes its findings: blind sentinels (ran before, now errored or stale), stale active programs, candidates aging unresolved, duplicate or overlapping programs, and supply. It reports; the per-program archive doors propose. Governed by the same machinery it maintains.
